scope: Corrected counter audit; complete censuses are evidence, not acceptance. No profiler or run.

method.cumulative_row_work: Per-rank EXIT snapshot minus per-rank QUALITY_ENTRY snapshot; every field reconciled against terminal_geometry_service_assessment.
method.quality_and_ladder_intervals: Sum post-entry counters across ownership/window/exit stages; ladder publications reconcile with global commits.
method.gauges_and_histograms: EXIT census only. Queue, blocked and stuck are gauges, never summed across windows. Location, miss, short-edge, geometry and target drift use EXIT snapshot only.
method.timer_interpretation: Rank timers overlap/nest; summed rank seconds are service counters, not global elapsed and not additive disjoint categories.
method.ladder_rejections: Source labels: geometry/topology, height, shape, progress, measurement, contact, dependency, no-candidate; flags may overlap.

published_commits_and_interval_counters.reconciliation: Ladder published commits sum = post-entry global commits.

exit_only_diagnostics.shortedge_definition: Among cells bad in q or J (union), at least one of six edges shorter than <0.9 or <0.5.

target_drift_exit.sample_scope: 16 GLOBAL fixed samples reported on each rank, not 96 independent samples. Tags current_nodal_sensor/full_target do not independently prove immutable original continuous CFD target fidelity.

exit_only_diagnostics.geometry_type_limit: Per-cell bit flags; a cell can count in multiple authority types, so their sum can exceed geometry-bad count.
